## Research support and proposal development

- **2026–present:** Active Mitacs Accelerate postdoctoral research with Healthy Lake Huron partners; ABCA is the formal Mitacs partner.
- **2024–2026:** Environment and Climate Change Canada funding supported PhD watershed and conservation research.
- **Professional practice:** Proposal development and resource mobilisation across BRAC, CARE Bangladesh, university, and international-development settings.
- **OMAFA proposal — under review:** Contributed to a precision-conservation proposal led by Dr. Prasad Daggupati. The proposed work extends my PhD using the Agricultural Conservation Planning Framework (ACPF) to compare conservation opportunities, benefits, and costs. If accepted, I would work with the project team. [Proposal details →](collaboration.qmd#omafa-precision-conservation-proposal)
- **[Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA) program](https://nserc-crsng.canada.ca/en/funding-opportunity/canada-postdoctoral-research-award-program) — application submitted:** Proposed food-system resilience research; no award is confirmed. [Research direction →](collaboration.qmd#food-system-resilience-and-anticipatory-decision-making)
